description: Label reduction makes merge-and-shrink abstractions smaller without losing information. A *label* is the operator name on a transition, and two labels are *locally equivalent* in a factor when they have the same transitions there. Before each merge, the crate combines labels of equal cost that are locally equivalent in every factor except one. This is *exact*: products and goal distances stay the same as with the original labels. Bisimulation can then group more states, so keep it on.
